axes_note.cash_amount: GatekeeperService.MAX_CASH_AMOUNT is 5000 with no SystemConfig override path. 5000 is the last accepted value and 5001 the first rejected one; the cap has no tenant or user scope.

rule: GatekeeperService.MAX_CASH_AMOUNT is 5000 and is a class constant with no SystemConfig override, so no tenant can raise its own ceiling. 5000 is the last accepted amount and 5001 the first rejected one. The cap is absolute, not scoped to a session or a user.
